idea-plugin.name: DSH for Desktop
idea-plugin.description:
DSH for Desktop brings DeepSeek Harness into your JetBrains IDE as a side panel.

Features

  • A dedicated tool window hosting the DSH web UI (JCEF).
  • One DSH process per IDE; the current project is selected through ideWorkspace.
  • Reuses the official DeepSeek Harness desktop runtime and shares ~/.dsh (credentials, settings, session history).
  • IDE bridge: click a file to open it in the IDE, right-click a file or an editor selection to insert an @reference into the composer, and keep the sidebar scoped to the current project.
  • On first run, the DSH language and theme are aligned with the IDE.

Requirements

  • A JetBrains IDE based on the 2024.3 platform or newer with the integrated JCEF browser.
  • The official DeepSeek Harness desktop application. When it is not installed, DSH for Desktop asks for your confirmation and then downloads the installer from download.deepseek.com.

Privacy

DSH for Desktop does not collect telemetry. It talks only to the local DSH server on 127.0.0.1 and, when you approve the installation of the desktop client, to download.deepseek.com. See the privacy policy for details.

DSH for Desktop is an independent, community-built integration. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by JetBrains or DeepSeek.

中文

在 JetBrains IDE 的侧边栏中使用 DeepSeek Harness：工具窗口内嵌 DSH 页面，与官方桌面端共享 ~/.dsh； 全 IDE 只运行一个 dsh 服务，项目通过 ideWorkspace 区分。

  • IDE bridge: open files in the IDE, insert file or selection references into the composer, project-scoped sidebar.
  • Automatic detection and installation of the official DeepSeek Harness desktop client.
  • Language and theme follow the IDE on first run.
